The abstract outlines that extracellular vesicle and exosome isolation methods exist but have significant limitations, and it highlights emerging microfluidic approaches. It does not describe or evaluate any of the specific integrated platforms combining acoustofluidics, deep learning, surface plasmon resonance imaging (SPRi), or size‑exclusion chromatography (SEC) that are proposed in the four candidate hypotheses. Consequently, none of the hypotheses aligns with the evidence presented in the study.

VERDICT 1: REJECT
